title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Use image 1 only as the visual style reference. Transform the control-room concept into a structured bilingual engineering infographic for Agent runtime cost governance. Keep the warm paper, graphite engineering sketch and restrained watercolor palette. The information labels must be the visual focus.

Brand header: place the official black OpenAI Blossom symbol in a quiet white-paper area with proper proportions and clear space, followed by the exact wordmark "OpenAI" and product label "CODEX". Do not modify or texture the logo.

Exact title: "Agent Runtime Cost Governance"
Exact Chinese subtitle: "六条成本治理原则"

Arrange six equal control modules around a central usage meter. Each module has exactly one label:
1. "Token 有 Owner"
2. "后台 Worker 有 Lifecycle"
3. "Retry 有上限"
4. "Root 持有成本策略"
5. "Typed Canonical Representation"
6. "Background Cost 可观测"

Connect every module to the central meter with clean pipes or circuit lines. Use a small valve, circuit breaker, hierarchy tree or typed-data icon to reinforce meaning. All text must be exact, dark, large and readable. Use no other labels or fake technical text. The final image should function as a summary diagram that readers can study, not as a mood illustration.
